summary: Tested new Galeria de Cortes feature (admin upload/delete + public gallery with lightbox) and updated hero copy. All backend endpoints (8 pytest cases) and frontend UI flows passed. Gallery left empty after cleanup.

Minor: /api/gallery has no pagination; .to_list(200) hard caps at 200 items. Fine for current scale.
seed_data_creation: Created temp TEST_UI_cut gallery item + TEST_gallery_client user; gallery items deleted at end. Test user remains (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery CRUD, auth gates (401/403), 400 non-image rejection, 404 unknown delete, lightbox open/close, hero welcome+delay note copy, absence of 'atualiza automaticamente' all verified. Barbers untouched.
